audit.why: Riven at 1-2, level at 4-6, Akali on the item stages matches 53.13% Emerald+ over 2448 games and both on-disk charts. Charts untouched.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was untouched template text, breakdown.spikes named 'Blade of the Exile at 6' with no cooldown, and gave Akali 'levels 2-3'.
audit.why: Blade of the Exile is 120/90/60s and does two things worth knowing: it adds attack RANGE as well as damage, and it grants one Wind Slash - a ranged finisher. A melee assassin planning her disengage needs to know Riven's threat range grows at 6. Twilight Shroud is also not learnable before level 3.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why and breakdown.spikes rebuilt on the 120s, the added range and the Wind Slash, and on level 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Broken Wings is described as 'three dashes' with no cooldown, and the content layer twice refers to Akali having 'kunai-sustain'.
audit.why: Broken Wings is a single flat 13s cooldown covering all three casts, with the third knocking back - so a Riven who has spent the sequence into the wave is on a genuinely long timer, which is the whole reason the content layer's 'let her shove and waste those cooldowns' advice works. And Akali has no sustain of any kind: her kit contains no heal, so 'kunai-sustain' was inventing a resource.
audit.corrected: report[5].t now carries the flat 13s; content whys[0], whys[2], spikes[0].text and wants.foe[0] drop the sustain claim and state Shroud arrives at 3.

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization ends 'Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.'
audit.why: Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit - no heal flag on any of her five abilities, and Valor is a shield, not a heal. Grievous Wounds is dead gold in this lane, and the line also calls her 'his'. Buying it costs a real item slot in the exact window the rest of the page tells you to force the all-in.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now says to skip anti-heal and explains why.

edits.before: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Lich Bane / Hextech Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame / Zhonya's Hourglass; boots Plated Steelcaps. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Blade + pot. Core: Lich Bane / Hextech Rocketbelt, then Shadowflame / Zhonya's Hourglass; boots Plated Steelcaps. Skip anti-heal entirely — Riven has no healing anywhere in her kit.

edits.before: Both R casts turn survived all-ins into executes. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Riven's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile is 120s and adds attack range plus one Wind Slash. Reassess every all-in at 6 — hers reaches now.

edits.after: Riven: Valor's shield, Blade of the Exile at 6 (120s), first item. Akali: level 3 (Shroud), Lich Bane, and the 2-item window.

edits.after: Broken Wings is a single flat 13s covering all three casts — the third one knocks back.

edits.after: Riven's level-1 Broken Wings dashes and raw stats beat your single Q, and you have no Shroud until level 3.

edits.after: Even-ish: she still out-bullies you, but your Q fan farms safely at range and Shroud answers her dashes.

edits.after: Riven's window: her Broken Wings dashes plus a W (Ki Burst) stun let her commit a full burst combo before you have Shroud at level 3, and she out-stats your single Q.

edits.after: Bully you out of XP and CS at levels 1-3 with Broken Wings dash aggression, before your Shroud is even online

notes: The Itemization line told you to rush Grievous Wounds against a champion with no healing in her kit — that is a wasted component in exactly the window the rest of the page tells you to all-in. The same 'his healing fights your pattern' sentence appears verbatim in several other Akali entries where it IS correct (Nasus, Mordekaiser, Maokai), so it looks like a shared template that was applied without checking Riven's kit; worth a sweep.
